title: calispermum oblongifolium
intro: Calispermum oblongifolium, commonly known as Calophyllum, is a plant species belonging to the family Calophyllaceae. This plant is prized for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, prevent infections, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Calispermum oblongifolium include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit neuroprotective effects, making it a potential treatment for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, tannins, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource for traditional medicine.
